name: Capafy AI
tagline: AI images and videos with clear credit pricing
description: Capafy AI is an AI image and video workspace for creators and teams. Start with text or reference images, select an available model and its supported controls, and generate visuals for creative work. A credit quote is shown before creation, and finished work can be kept in a private creative library. Generation requires an account and funded credits; there is no free generation tier. Model capabilities and output characteristics vary, so users should review results and the relevant model terms before using them.
